description: CoChat brings verifiable academic research into ChatGPT. Search across CrossRef, Semantic Scholar, arXiv, PubMed, OpenAlex, ClinicalTrials, and more — and get real metadata with real DOIs. Verify whether a quoted claim actually appears in its cited paper (and catch misattribution), and confirm a citation's DOI/title before you rely on it. For multi-paper literature reviews, persistent citation libraries, and PRISMA-grade workflows, continue in the full CoChat workspace at app.cochat.ai.

defaultPrompt: Find recent peer-reviewed papers on [topic] and summarize the key findings with full citations.
Check the citations in this draft — does each reference actually support the claim it's attached to?
